text.en: The sitio of Cap-on in the Barrio of Candelaria, Municipality of Matag-ob, Province of Leyte, is hereby separated from said barrio, and constituted into a distinct and independent barrio of said municipality, to be known as the Barrio of San Sebastian.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 19, 1971.
